educationalModelNote: All numerical models are simplified educational models, not specifications of a real robot.

missions.title: ENERGY VS POWER
missions.concept: Energy determines how long the robot can operate; power determines what it can do at a moment. They are related but not interchangeable.
missions.scenario: Size a mission that must patrol for an hour and still perform short high-power recovery events.
missions.goalText: Provide more than one hour of planned runtime with reserve; peak power is tracked separately.
missions.transferText: Recover runtime after average mission power rises.

missions.title: BATTERY & BMS
missions.concept: Pack voltage, capacity, state of charge and BMS current limits jointly determine available energy and peak capability.
missions.scenario: Keep a battery inside reserve and current limits while supporting a 6 kW event.
missions.goalText: Support the power event while preserving usable mission reserve.
missions.transferText: Adapt the electrical operating point when low SoC reduces current headroom.

missions.title: REGENERATION & POWER FLOW
missions.concept: Regenerative braking only recovers energy that the bus and battery can accept; near full charge, returned power may need to be limited or dissipated.
missions.scenario: Descend a ramp while multiple joints regenerate into a battery with finite charge acceptance.
missions.goalText: Keep returned power within the pack's current acceptance envelope.
missions.transferText: Reduce regen demand or increase the external dissipation/acceptance margin when charge acceptance collapses.

missions.title: HEAT & COOLING
missions.concept: Thermal resistance sets steady temperature rise; thermal capacitance buys transient time. Cooling paths, not visual vent count, determine sustainable capability.
missions.scenario: Keep an actuator housing below its temperature limit during sustained loss.
missions.goalText: Create sustainable thermal margin under the current loss.
missions.transferText: Recover continuous capability after cooling degrades.

missions.title: DOCKING, DERATING & SEALING
missions.concept: Energy reserve, temperature, environmental sealing and docking availability are one mission-level operating problem.
missions.scenario: Decide when to leave patrol and reach the dock before energy or thermal derating removes capability.
missions.goalText: Keep enough reserve and thermal headroom to reach a dock safely.
missions.transferText: Shorten the mission or reach the dock before sealed-operation derating becomes critical.

missions.title: ENERGY GATE
missions.concept: Demonstrate runtime, peak-current, regeneration, thermal and safe-docking reasoning as one coupled energy architecture.
missions.goalText: Complete the three energy gate cases.

gateCases.name: RUNTIME
gateCases.text: Plan at least 90 min plus 15% energy reserve.

gateCases.name: PEAK CURRENT
gateCases.text: At 72 V, keep an 8 kW event below 125 A.

gateCases.name: THERMAL / SAFE STATE
gateCases.text: Preserve >8°C thermal margin and >150 Wh after the 90-minute mission.
